what: Energy ledger recomputed with circuit-measured analog front-end power, MC 95% CIs
headline: With the circuit-measured 246 mW front end (full 32-mode Q=40 bank) the continuous-digital advantage is 5.0x vs SoC (95% CI [3.82, 6.77]) and 1.46x vs an edge NPU (CI [1.16, 2.36]); the duty-cycle crossover is 18.5% (CI [13.0, 24.0]). The lean 12-mode bank (95.8 mW, 0.357 5-class -- it Pareto-dominates the 16-mode point) gives 11.0x/3.22x, crossover 7.2%. The edge-NPU ratio is FRAGILE: it assumes a 300 mW shared front end; for a sub-kHz UATR band a 30-50 mW front end pushes the full-bank edge-NPU ratio below 1 (0.55x), so the robust claim rests on the continuous-SoC comparison and the sub-watt-platform capability argument, not the edge-NPU number.
